notes.title: small key fix
notes.content:
This patch addresses missing keys at some mobs.

Players with faster rigs used to experience this bug since the older iteration of the game based action on how fast your pc handled the physics. This is not the case anymore, but some bugs stayed hidden.

notes.title: Patch v 1.35
notes.content:
Full list of changes

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] Heavy and light attacks are getting separate buttons. This change will enable faster shooting and more fluid gameplay. 
[*] Controls are getting rehashed, so now there are more convenient control setups for the keyboard and controller.
[*] Stamina balancing - some activities were draining too much stamina at the start level, so new changes address this problem.
[/list]
[b]AI[/b]
[list]
[*] Plants sometimes pause mid-attack, breaking their attack loop. This patch fixes this problem. 
[/list]
[b]Level Design & Effects[/b]
[list]
[*] The bug where some of the traps were not colliding with the player - fixed. 
[*] New sound effects for various levels and actions are now present.
[*] All types of Lizards get new designs - color and normal maps.
[*] All plants had the wrong color lips when spitting - fixed.
[*] Some particles during fireball creation were not showing - fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: FREE DEMO
notes.content:
You can check out the game now by trying the free demo of the game.

After new updates and changes that have addressed player controls and the number of changes to character gravity and collisions, it was only fair to allow you to try out the new gameplay.

Accumulative changes in version 1.32 :
-Camera fixes ( better following )
-Gravity tweaking ( the player has more time to maneuver while in the air)
-Collision refinement ( some platforms and walls fixed )
-Ui changed regarding the new controls
-Enemy balancing ( not so steep learning curve )

notes.title: Controls system redone + bug fixes
notes.content:
Number of changes regarding controls of the character and UI

-Keyboard controls offer more freedom to the player
-Multiple control schemes
-UI now adjusted to the type of preferred control schemes
-Bugs regarding some of the collisions fixed

notes.title: Update Notice - 2 Jan
notes.content:
There will be an update on 2 January to fix a few bugs and make some improvements. That will be the first post-release update.

Here are the contents of this update:
-Tweaked Physics. The player has more time to maneuver while in the air
-Camera follows the character more tightly
-Platforms are more reachable

I wish you all the best in the New 2021 !!!
